related_resources.reason: Dominated convergence and convergence in L-one, including the Fatou lemma proof and sharp nonexamples.
Lectures 4–5 and 12–13: Fatou, DCT, a.e. convergence, and convergence in measure.
Companion treatment of convergence theorems and why integral-limit interchange needs hypotheses.

description: Uses shrinking spikes and escaping mass to show why pointwise limits need not commute with integration, then proves dominated convergence using Fatou's lemma and one integrable majorant, including the stronger conclusion of convergence in the L1 norm.
